name: Route Z
storyline: The world's been overrun by zombies, everyone you've ever known has perished and you're running out of gas. There's only one route left. Barrel through hordes of zombies in search of fuel and armor. How far can you make it without wrecking your ride?
summary: A 3D endless-runner mobile game where you drive across a place that has been overrun by zombies. You can upgrade your car or buy other vehicles, but you'll need to run over, shoot and smash as many zombies as you can to gain coins (in-game currency) to be able to do so. Explore different scenarios, such as a desert or a city, where you'll face many threats along your way. Resource management for each run is essential to drive as far as you can, since fuel is scarce and burns fast.
